neighbours.label: a single-unit quantifier in a quantitative or causal statement ('per', 'a single', 'one', 'a' before one particle or cell): the token that sets up one individual unit as the base of a rate or cause; plural and aggregate quantifiers (many, several, tons of) stay low
fire: In some wasps a single egg can split into hundreds of separate larvae.
The engine burns roughly six litres of fuel per hundred kilometres.
When a carbon nucleus captures a neutron, it becomes a heavier isotope.
Each adult fly lays its eggs one at a time, and a single larva hatches from each.
The firm reported earnings of two dollars per share for the year.
A human red blood cell carries about 270 million haemoglobin molecules per cell.
Even a single spore landing on the bread can start a mould colony.
The vaccine contains about ten micrograms of antigen per dose.
quiet: In some wasps many eggs are laid together inside a caterpillar.
The engine burns a lot of fuel on long trips across the mountains.
When carbon nuclei collide in stars, they form heavier elements over time.
Adult flies lay their eggs in batches, and many larvae hatch together.
The firm reported strong earnings across all of its divisions this year.
Human red blood cells carry oxygen through the body to all tissues.
Several kinds of mould can grow on bread kept in a warm kitchen.
The vaccine is stored in large boxes in the hospital refrigerator.

short: single unit as base of a rate or cause (per / a single)
notes: Card: 'after ingesting one egg', 'when a spermatozoon makes contact', '1000-2000 mitochondria per cell', 'absorbs a neutron', '$0.85 per share', 'a single fertilized egg', 'for every 100 tons'; + side suppresses ' single', ' every', ' molecule', ' neuron' and promotes 'some', 'batches', 'set'. Probe: 'a single fertilized egg' 0.692, 'mitochondria per cell' 0.501, '85 cents per share' 0.502, 'absorbs a neutron' 0.406, 'swallows one egg' 0.272; 'swallows many eggs' 0.143, 'For every hundred tons' 0.080, 'a small piece of root' 0.042.
